configuration.selection_data: phrase model selected on original development only; broader training verified on combined development after first transfer failure
configuration.selection_rule: lowest mean full-coverage development errors across seeds 7,42,2026
configuration.transfer_failure: Original-data-only phrase model reduced original errors but regressed on CEAS; CEAS is now training/development data, not a fresh validation claim
configuration.guard: review for scorer disagreement, fewer than 5 tokens, or more than 50% unknown words; also bottom-decile Syntra calibration margin

data.external_scope: TREC 2006-derived email/spam labels, published by curators in 2023; separate corpus, not a newer-campaign temporal test

checks.reproduction_note: TREC06 was unseen in the first final evaluation; rerunning is reproducibility evidence, not a new untouched test

timing_scope: batch text scoring and embedded decision calls separately; no HTTP, disk persistence, parsing or training in timings
